== English errata comparison sources ==
The original English Limited face names “Vader, Emperor Palpatine.” Decipher's 29 January 2002 Glossary Supplement and the complete D-E1 face say “Vader, Emperor.” The table uses the Supplement transcription, including its braces around the leader skill and its capitalization and punctuation. Both complete errata images mark the skill in bold and capitalize the names of the linked cards. The normal image has a D-E1 footer and the high-resolution image has an E stamp. The physical Revised face retains “Emperor Palpatine.” Revised and Virtual articles stay outside this English Decipher comparison.
